Chapter 1210 - 24: Evolution Of The Chaotic Taiji Dao (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1210: Chapter 24: Evolution of the Chaotic Taiji Dao (Please Subscribe)

"This giant core pillar is right next to me?"

Lin Yuan looked closely at a heavenly pillar ten times more majestic than the others, quickly manifesting from the illusion, feeling rather uneasy in his heart.

The entire time-space treasure land is vast, and the giant core pillar could have appeared anywhere; yet, it appeared next to Lin Yuan? Such odds are almost like finding a thirteenth-level inheritance while walking down the street.

"What to do?"

Lin Yuan looked at the giant core pillar before him, and after just a moment’s thought, made a decision.

Refine it.

Buzz!

Lin Yuan activated his outer cosmos and immediately began refining.

Fierce Sun Capital, independent space.

Red Flame Venerable stared at Lin Yuan in disbelief, "Are you saying that the giant core pillar is right next to you?"

"Yes."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The other numerous peak venerables were also somewhat stunned. They were just pondering where the giant core pillar might appear, yet it turned out to be so close to Galaxy Venerate.

"I’ve already started refining it."

Lin Yuan said immediately.

"Yes."

"You refine it now."

"I’ve already rushed over with full effort."

Red Flame Venerable said with solemnity.

He had originally given up on contending for the first giant core pillar, thinking it unnecessary to fight Fu Xu Venerate to the death.

But that was based on the premise that Fu Xu Venerate was the first to reach the giant core pillar and refine it first.

Forcibly taking the giant core pillar from Fu Xu Venerate’s hands would be too costly, and in the end, whether it could actually be taken was another matter.

Thus, after weighing the pros and cons, Red Flame Venerable chose to give up, which was also the most rational decision.

But now?

The giant core pillar appeared right next to Lin Yuan.

That means Lin Yuan is the first strong person to come into contact with the giant core pillar. In this situation, Red Flame Venerable hesitated almost not at all and chose to compete for this giant core pillar.

No choice.

This giant core pillar was practically delivered to him.

If Red Flame Venerable were to give up again, it would be too timid.

"Three breaths, I can use special means to reach you within three breaths; you just need to hold on for two breaths."

Red Flame Venerable said solemnly.

The killer weapon he brought from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, once used, could completely protect this giant core treasure land.

By then, if Fu Xu Venerate wanted to forcibly refine the giant core treasure land, a certain price would need to be paid. In this situation, as long as Fu Xu Venerate had some sense, he could completely choose to compete for the next giant core pillar that appeared in the world.

"I will try my best."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Fu Xu Venerate could arrive in one breath, while Red Flame Venerable could arrive in three breaths.

That means Lin Yuan needs to block Fu Xu Venerate for two breaths.

Actually, it couldn’t be said to block; as long as he could stall Fu Xu Venerate for two breaths, making it impossible for him to refine the giant core pillar, that would suffice.

...

Before the giant core pillar.

Lin Yuan took only ten breaths to successfully refine it.

All at once, Lin Yuan felt a significant reduction in the suppression of this treasure land time-space over him.

At the same time, with the aid of this giant core pillar, his numerous avatars could also descend instantly.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed as he saw ripples spreading in the space-time not far away, a man in a dark robe walking out.

"Fu Xu Venerate?"

Lin Yuan’s expression became solemn. The man in a dark robe was none other than Fu Xu Venerate, an existence on par with the Moyu Tower Master.

"How come so fast?"

Lin Yuan felt the pressure, for only a tenth of a breath had passed, and Fu Xu Venerate was already here?

There are two possibilities for this.

One is that Fu Xu Venerate had concealed his strength, and his true abilities were far beyond what had been shown over the past millennium.

The other is that Fu Xu Venerate also happened to be nearby, so his arrival speed exceeded Lin Yuan’s expectations.

"You’ve got quite the luck."

Fu Xu Venerate glanced at Lin Yuan, smiling as he spoke.

Given his speed, Lin Yuan had not only reached the giant core pillar but had also refined it by the time he arrived.

There was only one explanation.

That the giant core pillar appeared right by Lin Yuan.

"But unfortunately, you’ve encountered me."

Before Fu Xu Venerate’s words were finished, the surrounding space-time began to grow dim.

An aura of all things being void descended.

From the moment he arrived to when he spoke the second sentence, less than a ten-thousandth of a breath had passed, and Fu Xu Venerate acted directly, not delaying in the slightest.

"What?"

Lin Yuan frowned. Under this dark and illusory force, his divine ability ’World’ began to collapse and fade.

"Go away."

Fu Xu Venerate struck with his right hand, Lin Yuan’s face changed dramatically, his outer cosmos collapsing in an instant, and he was directly blasted away.

Swoosh.

Fu Xu Venerate took a step, standing next to the giant core pillar, then immediately began refining it. In the blink of an eye, he successfully erased Lin Yuan’s imprint and smoothly refined the giant core pillar.

"Fu Xu Venerate?"

Lin Yuan looked sullen. From Fu Xu Venerate’s arrival until now, only half a breath had passed.

"Is this the power comparable to an Invincible Great Saint?"

Lin Yuan took a deep breath. Although he wasn’t injured, under Fu Xu Venerate’s assault, he couldn’t resist at all and could only be passively knocked away.

"The thirteenth-level inheritance Fu Xu Venerate cultivated must be related to time."

From the brief engagement just now, Lin Yuan deduced a lot, realizing that when facing Fu Xu Venerate’s attack, the concept of time was completely scrambled, leaving him with no intention to actively counter it.

He entirely relied on passive defense from his outer cosmos.

"To withstand my strike without any serious injuries, you did quite well."

After successfully refining the giant core pillar, Fu Xu Venerate glanced at Lin Yuan and said with a hint of appreciation.

He was well aware of the technique he employed, which could block an enemy’s perception of time in an instant, forcing them to withstand several blows unprepared.

Under such circumstances, for Lin Yuan to only be knocked away with minor injuries was a testament to his formidable defense, rare even among the top Peak Venerables.

Swish.

Suddenly.

Not far away, slight ripples in time and space emerged.

A towering figure appeared, looking at the giant core pillar with a somewhat displeased expression.

"Fu Xu Venerate, you’re quite fast."

The towering figure said in a deep voice, having reached there quickly himself, yet Fu Xu Venerate still arrived a step ahead.

"Your Barbaric Wilderness Country went to great lengths to compete for this treasured land."

Fu Xu Venerate smiled slightly.

"Hmph."

The towering figure snorted coldly and vanished.

Had Fu Xu Venerate not refined the giant core pillar before he arrived, he would not have hesitated to contend for it.

But now?

With Fu Xu Venerate having refined the giant core Venerable, there was no point in competing.

Swish swish swish.

Next.

More figures appeared.

Gazing from afar at the giant core pillar.

"Fu Xu Venerate has refined it."

"As expected, who can contend with Fu Xu Venerate for the first giant core pillar?"

"Sigh... let’s wait for the next one."

The arriving Peak Venerables conversed among themselves and gradually withdrew.

...

"What a pity."

Red Flame Venerable shook his head slightly, then looked solemnly at Lin Yuan: "But it’s not without gains. At least we know that Fu Xu Venerate cultivates more than one thirteenth-tier inheritance, including one related to time."

Lin Yuan had just recounted to Red Flame Venerable the scenario when Fu Xu Venerate took action.

As Lin Yuan speculated, Red Flame Venerable also concluded that Fu Xu Venerate used a thirteenth-tier inheritance related to time.

Otherwise, Lin Yuan wouldn’t have had no thought of resistance.

It’s well known.

Although top Peak Venerables aren’t Fu Xu Venerate’s match, the gap isn’t as vast as imagined.

Especially Lin Yuan, whose profound foundation allows him to detonate his outer universe when necessary. He could stall long enough for Red Flame Venerable to arrive.

But in reality, Fu Xu Venerate didn’t give Lin Yuan the chance to go all out.

"Don’t worry, we never intended to seize the first giant core treasure land anyway."

Red Flame Venerate consoled Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan nodded without saying much.

...

In the Chaos Void.

Deep within the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, reflecting on the gap between himself and a powerhouse like Fu Xu Venerate.

"Compared to these peak level individuals, wielding more than one thirteenth-tier method, my advantage is almost wiped out." Lin Yuan assessed himself.

In terms of thirteenth-tier methods, Lin Yuan had the ’Infinite Void’ inheritance and the Divine Ability ’Fierce Sun Opening the Sky,’ which together equated to two thirteenth-tier methods.

But Fu Xu Venerate also possessed them.

Fu Xu Venerate had advantages that Lin Yuan didn’t.

Such as the path of evolution through Chaos Power.

And the advantage in terms of realm, among others.

And powerhouse like Fu Xu Venerate wasn’t the only one in Da Fu Ancient Country.

Even other five major Ancient Countries, like Fierce Sun Ancient Country and Xuanyin Ancient Country, had them too.

However, such powerhouses had nothing else to seek and were mostly preparing to make that leap; even if a new top-tier treasure land emerged, they couldn’t be persuaded to act.

Fu Xu Venerate came here purely because he happened to have nothing else to do.

"Take it slowly, I still have plenty of room for improvement."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts without any feelings of frustration.

Next.

Lin Yuan continued his cultivation.

"Infinite Void..." Lin Yuan focused on cultivating the third layer of this thirteenth-tier inheritance, feeling he was close to achieving it, which would lead to a transformation of his inner universe.

Just then —

Dong!

Dong!

Dong Dong Dong!

A deep and powerful sound suddenly emerged.

Lin Yuan seemed to sense something, immediately halting his cultivation of ’Infinite Void,’ and his consciousness incarnated to the highest point of his inner universe.

Here, Chaos Qi floated, myriad Chaos Rule essences writhed, and a massive egg entirely composed of Chaos Qi quietly floated there.

Dong Dong Dong!

A deep sound emanated from within the egg, as if evolving to give birth to something.

"Is my Chaotic Taiji Dao about to materialize?"

Lin Yuan carefully observed the giant egg.

Over time.

Cracking sounds appeared continuously on the egg, and numerous cracks surfaced, finally releasing forces of black and white that were distinctly separate yet mutually integrated.

The black and white forces continued to merge, containing the extreme powers of Taiyin and Taiyang. This terrifying aura naturally spread with the black-and-white power, instantly crushing layers of time and space, even causing large swathes of Chaos Qi to collapse.

"What is this power?"

The red-clad little girl resting against a jade gourd was suddenly startled awake, sensing an oppressive force that surpassed the pressure felt by any previous cultivator of the ’Infinite Void’ inheritance.
